rules: Red contributes 0 and doubles token immediately to its right
Blue worth 5 only if any Green appears anywhere to its left
Green worth 0 only when it occupies the last position
Doubling an inactive token always yields 0
mistakes: Red does not add 3; it is a modifier only
Red at last position is wasted — no fallback or carry-back
strategy: Work strictly left to right, resolving each token in order
Check activation conditions before applying any modifier

rules: Red contributes 0 but doubles the immediately next token's value.
Token base values: Blue=5, Green=2, Yellow=7, Red=0.
Non-Red tokens sum independently unless modified by Red.
mistakes: Red chaining does not multiply through multiple Reds.
Doubling Red still yields 0 — Red has no base value.
strategy: Identify all Red tokens and locate their immediate right neighbor.
Apply doubling, then sum all token contributions.
edge_cases: Red followed by Red: second Red doubles to 0, not Yellow.
